subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 05, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - October 05, 2026**

**Community News**

We're excited to announce that the Rust Foundation has posted the recordings from RustConf 2026! You can now watch the talks and sessions from the event on YouTube. Head over to the RustConf playlist to catch up on the latest developments in the Rust ecosystem.

**Practical Tip**

Did you know that you can easily update your AcreetionOS installation using the `sudo pacman -Syu` command? This will update all your packages to the latest versions, ensuring you have the latest security patches and features. Simply open a terminal and run the command to get started!

**Recent Development Activity**

* [commit] add _redirects: block scanner paths (.env, .git, wp-*, phpinfo, xmlrpc) in acreetionos-code.github.io
* [commit] features: fix broken before/after slider; add community appreciation page in acreetionos-code.github.io
* [commit] updating in AcreetionOS-Xlibre
* [commit] updating in AcreetionOS-Xlibre
* [commit] ci: add welcome message for first-time contributors in acreetionos-code-acreetionos-server
* [commit] ci: add ShellCheck linting for shell scripts in acreetionos-code-acreetionos-server
* [commit] ci: add GitHub → GitLab mirror workflow in acreetionos-code-acreetionos-mate

Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in the AcreetionOS community by following us on social media and joining our Discord server. Happy hacking!
